summary: Ogun State first-party OGPRS/OLARMS and SDI pointers were verified, establishing a state-level map/land-administration custodian. No anonymous Ijebu-Igbo parcel geometry, schema, CRS, or stable native parcel identity was obtained. This is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
queryOutcomes: English and Yoruba discovery queries and actual first-party URLs are recorded in the city record. Results establish Ogun State service pointers, not verified local parcel coverage.
requestOutcomes: Five routes were recorded: OGPRS web fetch timed out; local TLS-verified OGPRS GET was refused due to an expired certificate; OLARMS, the SDI catalogue, and the Ogun State service pointer were reviewed as HTTP-200 HTML evidence. No TLS bypass, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, private token, unsafe field, parcel ID, or geometry was requested or retained.
scopeLimits: State-level Ogun custodian is evidenced, but no Ijebu-Igbo-local registry office or city-specific parcel endpoint was verified.
No public parcel API, viewer configuration, schema, CRS, stable native parcel identity, or bounded geometry response was verified.
No exact WUP-point hit or miss was obtained; the exact point remains [6.97085327995435, 4.0003903827364] in latitude/longitude order.
Timeout and expired-certificate access limitations are not evidence of citywide absence.
Packet completion does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter.
excludedFields: tax/account/registration details beyond a safe native parcel ID
credentials, private tokens and personal data
nativeIdentityPolicy: No native parcel identity was observed; no synthetic identity was created. A future retained sample must contain exactly one stable native ID in properties and keep source field mapping in this review.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: No usable public parcel geometry service was reached. No hit/miss inference was made.
